[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/grafana/clickhouse-datasource/compare/v4.23.5...v4.24.0)

- **links:** let dashboards choose the tables trace and log links open ([#​2197](https://redirect.github.com/grafana/clickhouse-datasource/issues/2197)) ([5d08e4d](https://redirect.github.com/grafana/clickhouse-datasource/commit/5d08e4d55039b71adfbc3ebfcb812f2f1180b7e2))

- **adhoc:** handle trailing comments, set operations and keyword table names in ad-hoc filters ([#​2177](https://redirect.github.com/grafana/clickhouse-datasource/issues/2177)) ([e6debc1](https://redirect.github.com/grafana/clickhouse-datasource/commit/e6debc1c338f3da95437cf7579f2f49ba04cde98))

##### ✅ Tests

- **e2e:** check pool settings reach the backend through Save & test ([#​2185](https://redirect.github.com/grafana/clickhouse-datasource/issues/2185)) ([5c194a8](https://redirect.github.com/grafana/clickhouse-datasource/commit/5c194a832cd76697eff9e1921c2928cda0d132c6))

- add stable aggregate result job for the integration matrix ([#​2305](https://redirect.github.com/grafana/clickhouse-datasource/issues/2305)) ([7bf2e87](https://redirect.github.com/grafana/clickhouse-datasource/commit/7bf2e87187b39e56e884b5c09dbc60818aaeb756))

- build the dev catalog publish with go 1.27.4 ([#​2311](https://redirect.github.com/grafana/clickhouse-datasource/issues/2311)) ([0333ec7](https://redirect.github.com/grafana/clickhouse-datasource/commit/0333ec7b9da9310a2f7522215c7355206cfdb753))
